evidenceBasedConclusions.conclusion: The most defensible current assessment is based on “EU urges Member States to make a common age-verification app available by the end of 2026,” the strongest indexed record by source grade and evidence status.
evidenceBasedConclusions.evidence: The European Commission adopted a recommendation on 29 April 2026 urging Member States to accelerate rollout of the EU age-verification app. The app may operate independently or be integrated into a European Digital Identity Wallet.
evidenceBasedConclusions.limitations: One strong record cannot by itself prove a wider pattern, motive, conspiracy or command structure.
evidenceBasedConclusions.alternativeInterpretation: The record may have a narrower legal or factual meaning than the surrounding public narrative suggests.
